method:
Geometric-only downward translation of the actual B hold75 tool pose.

This is not a physics experiment: hand joints and jaw opening are frozen, and
tool bodies are translated together along world -Z for source-mesh queries.
limitations: All jaw-body orientations, relative opening and hand joints remain frozen.
A source intersection only indicates an obstruction along this imposed path; it does not prove support force, arrest, grip stability, or actual slip direction.
Original source mesh intersection differs from PhysX convex contact.
Thumb/index assigned broad-face elastomer pairs are retained as intended targets and excluded from non-target events; other target-pad side/friction forces are not modeled.
FCL witness depth is not a reliable maximum volumetric penetration depth.
